_doc: ILLUSTRATIVE — the launcher suite reads only its unit block. Example launch.json for a headless Mac reached over SSH, where the Owner pastes every launch line. Copied to ~/.claude/robowright/launch.json beside profile.md. Patterns are POSIX ERE as bash's [[ =~ ]] reads them; group_regex captures the tracker prefix (SMPL) from a bare key (SMPL-482) or a keyed dir name (SMPL-482-export-csv). repos lists the main clones the Owner-side tools may run git in; a project's robowright.json naming any other is refused, and with no repos nothing is trusted.
